source_of_measurement: Root-provided inspection of real 30-minute stage journal; bind final implementation review to the original inspection/backup receipt when available.
conditions: New journals use explicit immutable versioned lossless encoding; old plain journals stay readable without silent recompression or continuity bridging.
Keep the canonical decoded event hash chain unchanged, bound each decoded event, and verify both decoded and encoded counters transactionally/on open.
Quota accounts actual encoded bytes plus a documented row allowance; physical SQLite pages and WAL remain additional.
Larger capacity must be explicitly selected in the actual capture configuration, not merely allowed by a new maximum.
Decompression rejects over-limit output, truncated streams, unused/trailing data and invalid decoded JSON without any unbounded decompression or flush.
Add real backup round-trip and canonical chain/normalization equivalence controls, corruption/counter mismatch/quota controls, and measure actual compressed SQLite storage.
Status reports both counters, configured quota, DB/WAL sizes and disk reserve. Rate-based time remaining is labelled an estimate, distinct from qualified time coverage.
Budget host disk for the 4 GiB journal, working snapshot cache, retained generations and existing benchmark free-space guard.
Keep full-scan costs explicit; a 30-day same-rate trace implies about 1.52 million rows and 7.77 GB decoded. Do not claim successful 30-day refresh performance without representative evidence.
scope: Design advisory only; implementation, independent tests, actual configured storage and real continuous history remain pending. No source edits or live actions performed.
